```{r}
# ============================================================
#  DATA GENERATORS  (synthetic — matches assignment shapes)
# ============================================================
gen_loan_data <- function(n = 592, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  credit <- round(pmin(pmax(rnorm(n, 660, 90), 450), 820))
  approved <- ifelse(credit > quantile(credit, 0.42), "Yes", "No")
  income <- ifelse(approved == "Yes",
                   runif(n, 44000, 135000),
                   runif(n, 17000, 43000))
  data.frame(
    Age              = round(runif(n, 25, 60)),
    Income           = round(income),
    Credit_Score     = credit,
    Loan_Amount      = round(income * runif(n, 0.15, 0.35)),
    Employment_Years = round(runif(n, 0, 25)),
    Loan_Approved    = factor(approved, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )
}

gen_diabetes_data <- function(n = 768, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  age   <- round(runif(n, 21, 80))
  bmi   <- round(rnorm(n, 30, 6), 1)
  gluc  <- round(rnorm(n, 120, 28))
  bp    <- round(rnorm(n, 72, 12))
  insul <- round(rnorm(n, 85, 90))
  prob  <- plogis(-9 + 0.045*age + 0.10*bmi + 0.022*gluc)
  y     <- rbinom(n, 1, prob)
  data.frame(Age = age, BMI = bmi, Glucose = gluc,
             BloodPressure = bp, Insulin = insul,
             Diabetes = factor(ifelse(y == 1, "Yes", "No"),
                               levels = c("No", "Yes")))
}

gen_mall_data <- function(n = 220, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  k <- sample(1:3, n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.4, 0.35, 0.25))
  data.frame(
    Age            = c(30, 45, 55)[k] + rnorm(n, 0, 6),
    Annual_Income  = c(25, 60, 90)[k] + rnorm(n, 0, 8),
    Spending_Score = c(75, 55, 20)[k] + rnorm(n, 0, 9)
  )
}

gen_pca_data <- function(n = 300, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  z <- rnorm(n)
  data.frame(
    V1 = 2.0*z + rnorm(n, 0, 0.5),
    V2 = 1.8*z + rnorm(n, 0, 0.6),
    V3 = 1.5*z + rnorm(n, 0, 0.7),
    V4 = -0.5*z + rnorm(n, 0, 1.0),
    V5 = rnorm(n)
  )
}

gen_ts_data <- function() {
  set.seed(123)
  months <- 1:24
  trend  <- 25 + 0.4 * months
  seas   <- 6 * sin(2 * pi * months / 12)
  noise  <- rnorm(24, 0, 1.3)
  ts(trend + seas + noise, frequency = 12, start = c(2024, 1))
}

# ============================================================
#  HELPERS — confusion matrix & metrics
# ============================================================
cm_metrics <- function(pred, actual, positive = "Yes") {
  pred   <- as.character(pred)
  actual <- as.character(actual)
  TP <- sum(pred == positive & actual == positive)
  TN <- sum(pred != positive & actual != positive)
  FP <- sum(pred == positive & actual != positive)
  FN <- sum(pred != positive & actual == positive)
  acc  <- (TP + TN) / max(TP + TN + FP + FN, 1)
  prec <- TP / max(TP + FP, 1)
  rec  <- TP / max(TP + FN, 1)
  f1   <- if ((prec + rec) > 0) 2*prec*rec/(prec+rec) else 0
  spec <- TN / max(TN + FP, 1)
  tbl  <- matrix(c(TN, FN, FP, TP), nrow = 2, byrow = FALSE,
                 dimnames = list(Predicted = c("No", "Yes"),
                                 Actual    = c("No", "Yes")))
  list(TP=TP, TN=TN, FP=FP, FN=FN,
       Accuracy=acc, Precision=prec, Recall=rec,
       F1=f1, Specificity=spec, table=tbl)
}

scale_with <- function(tr, te, cols) {
  mu <- sapply(tr[, cols], mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  sg <- sapply(tr[, cols], sd,   na.rm = TRUE)
  sg[sg == 0] <- 1
  list(
    train = as.data.frame(scale(tr[, cols], center = mu, scale = sg)),
    test  = as.data.frame(scale(te[, cols], center = mu, scale = sg)),
    mu = mu, sg = sg
  )
}

# ============================================================
#  MODEL RUNNERS
# ============================================================
run_svm <- function() {
  data <- gen_loan_data()
  set.seed(123)
  idx  <- sample(nrow(data), 0.8 * nrow(data))
  tr   <- data[idx, ]; te <- data[-idx, ]
  feats <- c("Age","Income","Credit_Score","Loan_Amount","Employment_Years")
  sc <- scale_with(tr, te, feats)

  m <- e1071::svm(x = sc$train, y = tr$Loan_Approved,
                  kernel = "radial", cost = 1, gamma = 0.1,
                  probability = TRUE)
  pr <- predict(m, sc$test)
  cm <- cm_metrics(pr, te$Loan_Approved, "Yes")
  probs <- attr(predict(m, sc$test, probability = TRUE),
                "probabilities")[, "Yes"]
  roc <- pROC::roc(response = te$Loan_Approved, predictor = probs,
                   levels = c("No","Yes"), quiet = TRUE)
  list(model = m, cm = cm, roc = roc,
       data = data, pred = pr, actual = te$Loan_Approved,
       feats = feats, sc = sc, tr = tr, te = te)
}

run_xgb <- function() {
  data <- gen_loan_data()
  set.seed(123)
  idx  <- sample(nrow(data), 0.8 * nrow(data))
  tr   <- data[idx, ]; te <- data[-idx, ]
  feats <- c("Age","Income","Credit_Score","Loan_Amount","Employment_Years")

  xtr <- as.matrix(tr[, feats]); xte <- as.matrix(te[, feats])
  ytr <- as.integer(tr$Loan_Approved) - 1L
  yte <- as.integer(te$Loan_Approved) - 1L

  dtr <- xgb.DMatrix(xtr, label = ytr)
  dte <- xgb.DMatrix(xte, label = yte)
  params <- list(objective = "binary:logistic",
                 eval_metric = "logloss", max_depth = 4, eta = 0.1,
                 subsample = 0.8, colsample_bytree = 0.8)
  set.seed(123)
  m <- xgb.train(params = params, data = dtr, nrounds = 50, verbose = 0)

  probs <- predict(m, dte)
  pred  <- factor(ifelse(probs > 0.5, "Yes", "No"),
                  levels = c("No","Yes"))
  cm    <- cm_metrics(pred, te$Loan_Approved, "Yes")
  roc   <- pROC::roc(response = te$Loan_Approved, predictor = probs,
                     levels = c("No","Yes"), quiet = TRUE)
  imp   <- xgb.importance(model = m, feature_names = feats)

  list(model = m, cm = cm, roc = roc, importance = imp,
       data = data, pred = pred, actual = te$Loan_Approved,
       feats = feats, tr = tr, te = te)
}

run_rf <- function() {
  data(mtcars)
  set.seed(123)
  idx <- sample(nrow(mtcars), 0.8 * nrow(mtcars))
  tr  <- mtcars[idx, ]; te <- mtcars[-idx, ]
  m   <- randomForest::randomForest(mpg ~ ., data = tr,
                                    ntree = 200, mtry = 3,
                                    importance = TRUE)
  pr  <- predict(m, te)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((pr - te$mpg)^2))
  mae  <- mean(abs(pr - te$mpg))
  r2   <- 1 - sum((pr - te$mpg)^2) / sum((te$mpg - mean(te$mpg))^2)
  list(model = m, pred = pr, actual = te$mpg,
       rmse = rmse, mae = mae, r2 = r2,
       importance = importance(m), tr = tr, te = te)
}

run_knn <- function() {
  data(iris)
  df <- iris[iris$Species != "virginica", ]
  df$Species <- droplevels(df$Species)
  set.seed(123)
  idx <- sample(nrow(df), 0.8 * nrow(df))
  tr  <- df[idx, ]; te <- df[-idx, ]
  feats <- c("Sepal.Length","Sepal.Width","Petal.Length","Petal.Width")
  sc <- scale_with(tr, te, feats)
  pred <- class::knn(train = sc$train, test = sc$test,
                     cl = tr$Species, k = 5, prob = TRUE)
  prob_yes <- attr(pred, "prob")
  # positive class = versicolor
  prob_yes <- ifelse(pred == "versicolor", prob_yes, 1 - prob_yes)
  cm  <- cm_metrics(pred, te$Species, positive = "versicolor")
  roc <- pROC::roc(response = te$Species, predictor = prob_yes,
                   levels = c("setosa","versicolor"), quiet = TRUE)
  list(model = list(k = 5), cm = cm, roc = roc,
       pred = pred, actual = te$Species,
       feats = feats, sc = sc, tr = tr, te = te)
}

run_logit <- function() {
  data <- gen_diabetes_data()
  set.seed(123)
  idx  <- sample(nrow(data), 0.8 * nrow(data))
  tr   <- data[idx, ]; te <- data[-idx, ]
  m    <- glm(Diabetes ~ Age + BMI + Glucose + BloodPressure + Insulin,
              data = tr, family = binomial)
  probs <- predict(m, newdata = te, type = "response")
  pred  <- factor(ifelse(probs > 0.5, "Yes", "No"),
                  levels = c("No","Yes"))
  cm    <- cm_metrics(pred, te$Diabetes, "Yes")
  roc   <- pROC::roc(response = te$Diabetes, predictor = probs,
                     levels = c("No","Yes"), quiet = TRUE)
  list(model = m, cm = cm, roc = roc,
       pred = pred, actual = te$Diabetes,
       tr = tr, te = te)
}

run_km <- function() {
  data <- gen_mall_data()
  sc   <- scale(data)
  set.seed(123)
  km   <- kmeans(sc, centers = 3, nstart = 25)
  data$Cluster <- factor(km$cluster)
  sil <- silhouette(km$cluster, dist(sc))
  list(model = km, data = data, sil = sil,
       centers = km$centers, size = km$size)
}

run_pca <- function() {
  data <- gen_pca_data()
  pca  <- prcomp(data, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  sdev <- pca$sdev
  var_pct <- (sdev^2) / sum(sdev^2) * 100
  cum_pct <- cumsum(var_pct)
  list(model = pca, data = data, sdev = sdev,
       var_pct = var_pct, cum_pct = cum_pct)
}

run_arima <- function() {
  ts_data <- gen_ts_data()
  m       <- forecast::auto.arima(ts_data, seasonal = TRUE)
  fc      <- forecast::forecast(m, h = 6)
  adf     <- tseries::adf.test(ts_data)
  list(model = m, forecast = fc, ts = ts_data, adf = adf)
}

message("Training all models... This takes a few seconds.")
ALL <- list(
  svm   = run_svm(),
  xgb   = run_xgb(),
  rf    = run_rf(),
  knn   = run_knn(),
  logit = run_logit(),
  km    = run_km(),
  pca   = run_pca(),
  arima = run_arima()
)
message("✓ All models trained.")

# ============================================================
#  UI HELPERS
# ============================================================
metric_badge <- function(label, value, accent = "#0891b2") {
  div(class = "metric-badge", style = sprintf("border-color:%s40;", accent),
      div(class = "v", style = sprintf("color:%s;", accent), value),
      div(class = "l", label))
}

cm_gg <- function(cm_tbl) {
  df <- as.data.frame.table(cm_tbl, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(df) <- c("Predicted", "Actual", "Count")
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted, fill = Count)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Count), size = 7, fontface = "bold",
              color = "#0b1220") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#e0f2fe", high = "#0891b2") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
    coord_fixed()
}

roc_gg <- function(roc_obj, label = "Model") {
  df <- data.frame(fpr = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
                   tpr = roc_obj$sensitivities)
  ggplot(df, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                color = "#94a3b8") +
    geom_line(color = "#0891b2", linewidth = 1.4) +
    labs(title = sprintf("ROC Curve — %s (AUC = %.3f)",
                         label, as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))),
         x = "False Positive Rate", y = "True Positive Rate") +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

make_card <- function(p) {
  accent <- cat_colors[[p$category]]
  tags_list <- trimws(strsplit(p$tools, ",")[[1]])
  div(class = "pcard",
      onclick = sprintf(
        "Shiny.setInputValue('card_clicked', %d, {priority:'event'});", p$id),
      div(class = "pcard-head",
          div(class = "pcard-icon",
              style = sprintf("background:linear-gradient(135deg,%s,%s);",
                              accent, accent),
              icon(p$icon)),
          span(class = "pcard-cat", p$category)),
      h3(class = "pcard-title", p$title),
      p(class = "pcard-summary", paste("Project", p$id, "of 24 — see details in the modal.")),
      div(class = "pcard-tags",
          lapply(tags_list, function(t) span(class = "pcard-tag", t))),
      div(class = "pcard-footer",
          span(if (!is.na(p$live_lab)) "▶ Open live model" else "View project"),
          span(class = "arrow", icon("arrow-right")))
  )
}

make_kpi <- function(label, value, sub, variant = "") {
  div(class = paste("kpi", variant),
      div(class = "kpi-label", label),
      div(class = "kpi-value", value),
      div(class = "kpi-sub", sub))
}

.eyebrow .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#fbbf24;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(245,179,1,.2);animation:pulse 2s infinite;}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(245,179,1,.2);}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(245,179,1,.05);}}
.hero-name{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-weight:900;
  font-size:clamp(2.3rem,5vw,3.6rem);line-height:1.02;margin:0 0 12px;letter-spacing:-.03em;}
.hero-name .accent{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fbbf24 0%,#fb7185 55%,#a78bfa 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;}
.hero-role{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:1.05rem;
  color:#e2e8f0;font-weight:500;margin:0 0 16px;padding:6px 16px 6px 12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.2);border-radius:999px;}
.hero-role .degree-tag{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fbbf24,#f97316);color:#0b1220;
  font-weight:800;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.03em;}
.hero-bio{font-size:1.02rem;line-height:1.65;color:#cbd5e1;max-width:620px;margin:6px 0 26px;}
.hero-badges{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-bottom:26px;}
.hero-badges .chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 14px;
  border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.22);
  color:#e2e8f0;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:500;backdrop-filter:blur(4px);transition:all .2s ease;}
.hero-badges .chip:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.hero-badges .chip i{color:#fbbf24;}
.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.btn-gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fbbf24 0%,#f97316 100%)!important;
  color:#0b1220!important;font-weight:700!important;border:none!important;
  border-radius:12px!important;padding:12px 24px!important;
  box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(251,191,36,.35)!important;transition:transform .2s ease!important;}
.btn-gold:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
.btn-ghost{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important;color:#f8fafc!important;
  border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.3)!important;border-radius:12px!important;
  padding:12px 22px!important;font-weight:600!important;text-decoration:none!important;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;transition:all .2s ease;}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)!important;transform:translateY(-2px);}
.kpi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px;margin-bottom:30px;}
@media (max-width:900px){.kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
.kpi{padding:22px;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff 0%,#f8fafc 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 10px 30px -12px rgba(15,23,42,.14);
  transition:all .25s ease;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.kpi:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 18px 40px -14px rgba(79,70,229,.28);}
.kpi::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:4px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4f46e5,#06b6d4);}
.kpi.gold::before{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fbbf24,#f97316);}
.kpi.emerald::before{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#34d399,#059669);}
.kpi.rose::before{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fb7185,#e11d48);}
.kpi-label{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;}
.kpi-value{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-weight:800;font-size:2rem;line-height:1;color:var(--ink);}
.kpi-sub{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px;}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:20px;}
.pcard{padding:22px;border-radius:18px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px -12px rgba(15,23,42,.12);
  transition:transform .28s ease,box-shadow .28s ease,border-color .28s ease;
  cursor:pointer;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:250px;}
.pcard::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:auto -30% -40% auto;width:180px;height:180px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(79,70,229,.08),transparent 70%);
  transition:transform .35s ease;pointer-events:none;}
.pcard:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 22px 44px -18px rgba(79,70,229,.35);
  border-color:rgba(79,70,229,.28);}
.pcard:hover::after{transform:scale(1.3);}
.pcard-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:16px;}
.pcard-icon{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-size:1.05rem;
  box-shadow:0 10px 22px -8px rgba(15,23,42,.35);}
.pcard-cat{font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:800;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#f1f5f9;
  color:#475569;border:1px solid var(--line);}
.pcard-title{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.15rem;
  margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.01em;}
.pcard-summary{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ink-2);line-height:1.55;margin:0 0 16px;flex-grow:1;}
.pcard-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.pcard-tag{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.68rem;padding:3px 8px;
  border-radius:6px;background:#eef2ff;color:#4338ca;border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.18);}
.pcard-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:12px;}
.pcard-footer .arrow{transition:transform .28s ease;}
.pcard:hover .pcard-footer .arrow{transform:translateX(4px);color:var(--brand);}
.filter-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:24px;
  padding:14px 18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.8);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:16px;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);}
.filter-bar .form-control,.filter-bar .form-select{border-radius:10px!important;
  border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.35)!important;font-size:.9rem;padding:9px 14px;background:#fff;}
.filter-bar .form-control:focus,.filter-bar .form-select:focus{
  border-color:var(--brand)!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(79,70,229,.12)!important;}
.metric-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(130px,1fr));
  gap:12px;margin-bottom:20px;}
.metric-badge{padding:16px;border-radius:14px;text-align:center;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ecfeff,#eff6ff);
  border:1px solid rgba(6,182,212,.3);}
.metric-badge .v{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:800;line-height:1;}
.metric-badge .l{font-size:.68rem;color:#475569;text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:1px;font-weight:700;margin-top:6px;}
.model-panel{padding:8px 0;}
.model-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:22px;}
@media (max-width:900px){.model-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.predict-box{padding:20px;border-radius:16px;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f8fafc 0%,#eef2ff 100%);
  border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.2);margin-top:22px;}
.predict-box h4{margin-top:0;font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.predict-result{margin-top:16px;padding:18px;border-radius:14px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ecfeff,#cffafe);
  border:1px solid rgba(6,182,212,.35);font-size:1.05rem;}
.predict-result .verdict{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-weight:800;
  font-size:1.5rem;color:#0e7490;}
.predict-result .conf{font-size:.9rem;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;}
.skills-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(320px,1fr));gap:20px;}
.skill-card{padding:24px;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff 0%,#f8fafc 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 10px 30px -14px rgba(15,23,42,.14);
  transition:all .25s ease;}
.skill-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:rgba(79,70,229,.3);}
.skill-card h4{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:1.15rem;margin:0 0 14px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.skill-card h4 i{color:var(--brand);}
.skill-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  margin:10px 0;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ink-2);}
.skill-bar{height:8px;background:#e2e8f0;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;margin:6px 0 14px;}
.skill-bar span{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:6px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4f46e5,#06b6d4);}
.skill-bar.gold span{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fbbf24,#f97316);}
.skill-bar.emerald span{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#34d399,#059669);}
.about-card{padding:32px;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff 0%,#f8fafc 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 14px 40px -16px rgba(15,23,42,.18);margin-bottom:20px;}
.about-card p{font-size:.96rem;line-height:1.75;color:var(--ink-2);}
.about-card h3{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;margin-top:0;color:var(--ink);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.about-card h3 i{color:var(--gold);}
.modal-content{border-radius:22px!important;border:none!important;
  box-shadow:0 40px 100px -20px rgba(11,18,32,.55)!important;overflow:hidden;}
.modal-header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0b1220 0%,#1e293b 100%);
  color:#f8fafc;border:none!important;padding:24px 28px;}
.modal-header .modal-title{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.35rem;}
.modal-body{padding:26px 28px 30px;}
.modal-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line)!important;padding:16px 24px;}
.modal .cat-badge{font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:800;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  color:#f8fafc;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);}
.modal .tag{display:inline-block;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.72rem;
  padding:4px 10px;border-radius:8px;background:#eef2ff;color:#4338ca;
  margin:2px 6px 2px 0;border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.18);}
.footer{text-align:center;padding:34px 20px 6px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.86rem;}
.footer .heart{color:#e11d48;}
.footer .brand-mark{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);}
.mb-20{margin-bottom:20px;}
.mt-24{margin-top:24px;}
.nav-tabs .nav-link{color:#475569;font-weight:600;border:none!important;
  padding:.6rem 1rem;border-radius:10px;margin-right:4px;}
.nav-tabs .nav-link.active{color:#4f46e5!important;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(79,70,229,.1),rgba(6,182,212,.1));}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px;height:10px;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#eef2f7;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#cbd5e1;border-radius:8px;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:#94a3b8;}
"

# ============================================================
#  THEME
# ============================================================
app_theme <- bs_theme(
  version = 5, primary = "#4f46e5", secondary = "#06b6d4",
  success = "#34d399", warning = "#fbbf24", danger = "#e11d48",
  bg = "#f6f7fb", fg = "#0b1220",
  base_font = font_google("Inter"),
  heading_font = font_google("Fraunces"),
  code_font = font_google("JetBrains Mono")
)

# ============================================================
#  LIVE LAB UI PANELS
# ============================================================
svm_panel <- function() {
  div(class = "model-panel",
    div(class = "metric-row",
        metric_badge("Accuracy",  sprintf("%.1f%%", ALL$svm$cm$Accuracy*100)),
        metric_badge("Precision", sprintf("%.3f",  ALL$svm$cm$Precision), "#0e7490"),
        metric_badge("Recall",    sprintf("%.3f",  ALL$svm$cm$Recall),    "#f59e0b"),
        metric_badge("F1",        sprintf("%.3f",  ALL$svm$cm$F1),        "#a78bfa"),
        metric_badge("AUC",       sprintf("%.3f",  as.numeric(pROC::auc(ALL$svm$roc))), "#34d399")),
    div(class = "model-grid",
        div(plotOutput("svm_cm",  height = "360px")),
        div(plotOutput("svm_roc", height = "360px"))),
    div(class = "predict-box",
        h4(icon("wand-magic-sparkles"), "Score a new applicant"),
        layout_columns(col_widths = c(3,3,2,2,2),
          numericInput("svm_age",   "Age",              value = 35, min = 18, max = 80),
          numericInput("svm_inc",   "Income",           value = 80000, step = 1000),
          numericInput("svm_cs",    "Credit Score",     value = 720, min = 300, max = 850),
          numericInput("svm_loan",  "Loan Amount",      value = 20000, step = 1000),
          numericInput("svm_emp",   "Employment Years", value = 8,   min = 0,  max = 50)),
        actionButton("svm_go", "Predict", class = "btn-gold", icon = icon("bolt")),
        uiOutput("svm_prediction"))
  )
}

xgb_panel <- function() {
  div(class = "model-panel",
    div(class = "metric-row",
        metric_badge("Accuracy",  sprintf("%.1f%%", ALL$xgb$cm$Accuracy*100)),
        metric_badge("Precision", sprintf("%.3f",  ALL$xgb$cm$Precision), "#0e7490"),
        metric_badge("Recall",    sprintf("%.3f",  ALL$xgb$cm$Recall),    "#f59e0b"),
        metric_badge("F1",        sprintf("%.3f",  ALL$xgb$cm$F1),        "#a78bfa"),
        metric_badge("AUC",       sprintf("%.3f",  as.numeric(pROC::auc(ALL$xgb$roc))), "#34d399")),
    div(class = "model-grid",
        div(plotOutput("xgb_cm",  height = "360px")),
        div(plotOutput("xgb_roc", height = "360px"))),
    h4(icon("ranking-star"), "Feature Importance (Gain)"),
    plotOutput("xgb_imp", height = "380px"),
    div(class = "predict-box",
        h4(icon("wand-magic-sparkles"), "Score a new applicant"),
        layout_columns(col_widths = c(3,3,2,2,2),
          numericInput("xgb_age",   "Age",              value = 35, min = 18, max = 80),
          numericInput("xgb_inc",   "Income",           value = 80000, step = 1000),
          numericInput("xgb_cs",    "Credit Score",     value = 720, min = 300, max = 850),
          numericInput("xgb_loan",  "Loan Amount",      value = 20000, step = 1000),
          numericInput("xgb_emp",   "Employment Years", value = 8,   min = 0,  max = 50)),
        actionButton("xgb_go", "Predict", class = "btn-gold", icon = icon("rocket")),
        uiOutput("xgb_prediction"))
  )
}

rf_panel <- function() {
  div(class = "model-panel",
    div(class = "metric-row",
        metric_badge("RMSE", sprintf("%.2f", ALL$rf$rmse), "#e11d48"),
        metric_badge("MAE",  sprintf("%.2f", ALL$rf$mae),  "#f59e0b"),
        metric_badge("R²",   sprintf("%.3f", ALL$rf$r2),   "#34d399")),
    h4(icon("chart-line"), "Actual vs Predicted MPG (test set)"),
    plotOutput("rf_pred_plot", height = "360px"),
    h4(icon("ranking-star"), "Variable Importance"),
    plotOutput("rf_imp", height = "380px"))
  )
}

knn_panel <- function() {
  div(class = "model-panel",
    div(class = "metric-row",
        metric_badge("Accuracy",  sprintf("%.1f%%", ALL$knn$cm$Accuracy*100)),
        metric_badge("Precision", sprintf("%.3f",  ALL$knn$cm$Precision), "#0e7490"),
        metric_badge("Recall",    sprintf("%.3f",  ALL$knn$cm$Recall),    "#f59e0b"),
        metric_badge("F1",        sprintf("%.3f",  ALL$knn$cm$F1),        "#a78bfa")),
    div(class = "model-grid",
        div(plotOutput("knn_cm",  height = "360px")),
        div(plotOutput("knn_roc", height = "360px"))))
  )
}

logit_panel <- function() {
  div(class = "model-panel",
    div(class = "metric-row",
        metric_badge("Accuracy",  sprintf("%.1f%%", ALL$logit$cm$Accuracy*100)),
        metric_badge("Precision", sprintf("%.3f",  ALL$logit$cm$Precision), "#0e7490"),
        metric_badge("Recall",    sprintf("%.3f",  ALL$logit$cm$Recall),    "#f59e0b"),
        metric_badge("AUC",       sprintf("%.3f",  as.numeric(pROC::auc(ALL$logit$roc))), "#34d399")),
    div(class = "model-grid",
        div(plotOutput("logit_cm",  height = "360px")),
        div(plotOutput("logit_roc", height = "360px"))),
    h4(icon("table-list"), "Coefficients"),
    tableOutput("logit_coef"))
  )
}

km_panel <- function() {
  div(class = "model-panel",
    div(class = "metric-row",
        metric_badge("k",            "3"),
        metric_badge("Silhouette",   sprintf("%.3f", mean(ALL$km$sil[, 3])), "#34d399"),
        metric_badge("Total SS",     sprintf("%.0f", ALL$km$model$totss), "#a78bfa")),
    div(class = "model-grid",
        div(plotOutput("km_scatter", height = "420px")),
        div(plotOutput("km_sil",     height = "420px"))))
  )
}

pca_panel <- function() {
  div(class = "model-panel",
    div(class = "metric-row",
        metric_badge("PCs", "5"),
        metric_badge("PC1 var", sprintf("%.1f%%", ALL$pca$var_pct[1]), "#34d399"),
        metric_badge("PC1+PC2", sprintf("%.1f%%", ALL$pca$cum_pct[2]), "#a78bfa")),
    div(class = "model-grid",
        div(plotOutput("pca_scree", height = "380px")),
        div(plotOutput("pca_biplot", height = "380px"))))
  )
}

arima_panel <- function() {
  div(class = "model-panel",
    div(class = "metric-row",
        metric_badge("ADF p-value", sprintf("%.3f", ALL$arima$adf$p.value),
                     if (ALL$arima$adf$p.value < 0.05) "#34d399" else "#e11d48"),
        metric_badge("Order", paste(arimaorder(ALL$arima$model), collapse = ","), "#a78bfa"),
        metric_badge("AIC",   sprintf("%.1f", ALL$arima$model$aic))),
    h4(icon("arrow-trend-up"), "Series + 6-period Forecast"),
    plotOutput("arima_plot", height = "440px"))
  )
}

# ============================================================
#  UI
# ============================================================
ui <- page_navbar(
  id = "navbar",
  title = div(class = "brand-dot", "M"),
  window_title = "Makini Caleb · Portfolio",
  theme = app_theme, fillable = FALSE,
  header = tags$head(tags$style(HTML(custom_css))),

  # -------- HOME --------
  nav_panel("Home", value = "Home", icon = icon("house"),
    div(class = "page-wrap",
      div(class = "hero",
        div(class = "hero-inner",
          div(class = "eyebrow", span(class = "dot"), "PORTFOLIO · 2025"),
          h1(class = "hero-name", "Makini ", span(class = "accent", "Caleb")),
          div(class = "hero-role",
              span("BSc Maths", class = "degree-tag"),
              span("Data Scientist · Statistician · R Programmer")),
          p(class = "hero-bio",
            "Eight live machine-learning models. Twenty-four R projects. One
             dashboard. Every model below is trained in real time — click Live Lab
             to see confusion matrices, ROC curves and predictions."),
          div(class = "hero-badges",
              span(class = "chip", icon("chart-line"), "Statistics"),
              span(class = "chip", icon("brain"),       "Machine Learning"),
              span(class = "chip", icon("code"),        "R Programming"),
              span(class = "chip", icon("database"),    "Data Wrangling"),
              span(class = "chip", icon("clock"),       "Time Series"),
              span(class = "chip", icon("eye"),         "Explainable AI")),
          div(class = "hero-cta",
              actionButton("go_live", tagList(icon("bolt"), "Open Live Lab"),
                           class = "btn-gold"),
              actionButton("go_portfolio",
                           tagList(icon("layer-group"), "Explore Portfolio"),
                           class = "btn-ghost")))),

      div(class = "kpi-grid",
          make_kpi("Live Models", "8", "SVM · XGB · RF · KNN · Logit · KM · PCA · ARIMA"),
          make_kpi("Projects", "24", "R Markdown notebooks", "gold"),
          make_kpi("Disciplines", "7", "Foundations → Advanced", "emerald"),
          make_kpi("Language", "R", "tidyverse · caret · shiny", "rose")),

      div(class = "section-title", "Featured Projects"),
      p(class = "section-sub",
        "The projects tied to live models above — click any card to see details."),
      div(class = "grid",
          lapply(which(projects$featured), function(i) make_card(projects[i, ]))),

      div(class = "footer",
          "© 2025 · ", span(class = "brand-mark", "Makini Caleb · BSc Maths"),
          " — Crafted with ", span(class = "heart", "♥"), " in R Shiny"))
  ),

  # -------- PORTFOLIO --------
  nav_panel("Portfolio", value = "Portfolio", icon = icon("layer-group"),
    div(class = "page-wrap",
      div(class = "section-title", "Full Portfolio"),
      p(class = "section-sub",
        "24 projects across seven disciplines. Search or filter to narrow the view."),
      div(class = "filter-bar",
          div(style = "flex-grow:1; min-width:220px;",
              textInput("search", NULL,
                        placeholder = "🔍  Search title, tools, category…")),
          div(style = "min-width:220px;",
              selectInput("cat_filter", NULL,
                          choices = c("All categories",
                                      sort(unique(projects$category))),
                          selected = "All categories")),
          div(class = "mono",
              style = "font-size:.82rem; color:#64748b; padding:0 12px;",
              textOutput("result_count", inline = TRUE))),
      uiOutput("project_grid"),
      div(class = "footer",
          "© 2025 · ", span(class = "brand-mark", "Makini Caleb · BSc Maths")))
  ),

  # -------- LIVE LAB --------
  nav_panel("Live Lab", value = "Live Lab", icon = icon("flask"),
    div(class = "page-wrap",
      div(class = "section-title", "Live Model Lab"),
      p(class = "section-sub",
        "All eight models trained at startup. Real confusion matrices, real ROC curves,
         real predictions — nothing is faked."),
      navset_card_tab(
        id = "lab_tabs",
        nav_panel("SVM",              icon = icon("bolt"),             svm_panel()),
        nav_panel("XGBoost",          icon = icon("rocket"),           xgb_panel()),
        nav_panel("Random Forest",    icon = icon("tree"),             rf_panel()),
        nav_panel("KNN",              icon = icon("circle-nodes"),     knn_panel()),
        nav_panel("Logistic",         icon = icon("wave-square"),      logit_panel()),
        nav_panel("K-Means",          icon = icon("braille"),          km_panel()),
        nav_panel("PCA",              icon = icon("compress"),         pca_panel()),
        nav_panel("ARIMA",            icon = icon("clock"),            arima_panel())),
      div(class = "footer",
          "© 2025 · ", span(class = "brand-mark", "Makini Caleb · BSc Maths")))
  ),

  # -------- SKILLS --------
  nav_panel("Skills", value = "Skills", icon = icon("wand-magic-sparkles"),
    div(class = "page-wrap",
      div(class = "section-title", "Skills & Tooling"),
      p(class = "section-sub", "The stack behind every project."),
      div(class = "skills-grid",
        div(class = "skill-card",
            h4(icon("code"), "Programming"),
            div(class = "skill-row", span("R"), span("Advanced")),
            div(class = "skill-bar", span(style = "width:94%")),
            div(class = "skill-row", span("SQL"), span("Intermediate")),
            div(class = "skill-bar", span(style = "width:60%")),
            div(class = "skill-row", span("Python"), span("Intermediate")),
            div(class = "skill-bar", span(style = "width:55%")),
            div(class = "skill-row", span("R Markdown"), span("Advanced")),
            div(class = "skill-bar", span(style = "width:92%"))),
        div(class = "skill-card",
            h4(icon("chart-line"), "Statistics"),
            div(class = "skill-row", span("Hypothesis Testing"), span("Advanced")),
            div(class = "skill-bar gold", span(style = "width:92%")),
            div(class = "skill-row", span("Regression & ANOVA"), span("Advanced")),
            div(class = "skill-bar gold", span(style = "width:90%")),
            div(class = "skill-row", span("Time Series"), span("Intermediate")),
            div(class = "skill-bar gold", span(style = "width:80%")),
            div(class = "skill-row", span("Experimental Design"), span("Intermediate")),
            div(class = "skill-bar gold", span(style = "width:72%"))),
        div(class = "skill-card",
            h4(icon("brain"), "Machine Learning"),
            div(class = "skill-row", span("Supervised"), span("Advanced")),
            div(class = "skill-bar emerald", span(style = "width:90%")),
            div(class = "skill-row", span("Unsupervised"), span("Advanced")),
            div(class = "skill-bar emerald", span(style = "width:84%")),
            div(class = "skill-row", span("Evaluation"), span("Advanced")),
            div(class = "skill-bar emerald", span(style = "width:88%")),
            div(class = "skill-row", span("Explainable AI"), span("Intermediate")),
            div(class = "skill-bar emerald", span(style = "width:74%"))),
        div(class = "skill-card",
            h4(icon("flask"), "Libraries"),
            div(class = "pcard-tags",
                lapply(c("tidyverse","dplyr","ggplot2","tidyr","caret","e1071",
                         "xgboost","randomForest","class","pROC","forecast",
                         "tseries","cluster","corrplot","broom","car","DALEX"),
                       function(t) span(class = "pcard-tag", t))))),
      div(class = "footer",
          "© 2025 · ", span(class = "brand-mark", "Makini Caleb · BSc Maths")))
  ),

  # -------- ABOUT --------
  nav_panel("About", value = "About", icon = icon("user"),
    div(class = "page-wrap",
      div(class = "section-title", "About"),
      div(class = "about-card",
          h3(icon("graduation-cap"), "Education"),
          p(strong("BSc Mathematics"),
            " — a rigorous foundation in real analysis, linear algebra, probability,
             statistical inference and mathematical modelling.")),
      div(class = "about-card",
          h3(icon("chart-line"), "Practice"),
          p("Across 24 R projects I work through the complete data-science stack: import,
             cleaning, missing-value imputation, exploratory analysis, hypothesis testing,
             regression, ANOVA, machine learning (SVM, XGBoost, Random Forest, KNN,
             logistic regression), unsupervised methods (K-Means, PCA), time-series
             forecasting (ARIMA) and explainability (DALEX).")),
      div(class = "about-card",
          h3(icon("paper-plane"), "Contact"),
          p("The full source of every project is available on request."),
          div(class = "hero-cta",
              tags$a(href = "mailto:makini.caleb@example.com",
                     class = "btn-gold", icon("envelope"), " Email"),
              tags$a(href = "#", class = "btn-ghost",
                     icon("file-lines"), " Download CV"))),
      div(class = "footer",
          "© 2025 · ", span(class = "brand-mark", "Makini Caleb · BSc Maths")))
  ),

  nav_spacer(),
  nav_item(tags$a(href = "https://github.com/", target = "_blank",
                  class = "nav-cta", icon("github"), "GitHub"))
)

# ============================================================
#  SERVER
# ============================================================
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  `%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || is.na(a)) b else a

  # ---- Navigation shortcuts ----
  observeEvent(input$go_live,      bslib::nav_select("navbar", "Live Lab"))
  observeEvent(input$go_portfolio, bslib::nav_select("navbar", "Portfolio"))
  observeEvent(input$go_about,     bslib::nav_select("navbar", "About"))

  # ========================================================
  #  LIVE LAB OUTPUTS
  # ========================================================

  # ---- SVM ----
  output$svm_cm  <- renderPlot({
    cm_gg(ALL$svm$cm$table) +
      labs(title = "SVM — Confusion Matrix") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  })
  output$svm_roc <- renderPlot(roc_gg(ALL$svm$roc, "SVM"))
  observeEvent(input$svm_go, {
    new <- data.frame(
      Age = input$svm_age, Income = input$svm_inc,
      Credit_Score = input$svm_cs, Loan_Amount = input$svm_loan,
      Employment_Years = input$svm_emp)
    scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(new, center = ALL$svm$sc$mu,
                                  scale  = ALL$svm$sc$sg))
    p <- predict(ALL$svm$model, scaled, probability = TRUE)
    probs <- attr(p, "probabilities")
    yes_p <- probs[1, "Yes"]
    verdict <- ifelse(yes_p > 0.5, "Approved ✓", "Rejected ✗")
    color   <- ifelse(yes_p > 0.5, "#0e7490", "#e11d48")
    output$svm_prediction <- renderUI({
      div(class = "predict-result",
          div(class = "verdict", style = sprintf("color:%s;", color), verdict),
          div(class = "conf",
              sprintf("P(Approved) = %.1f%%  ·  P(Rejected) = %.1f%%",
                      yes_p * 100, (1 - yes_p) * 100)))
    })
  })

  # ---- XGBoost ----
  output$xgb_cm  <- renderPlot({
    cm_gg(ALL$xgb$cm$table) +
      labs(title = "XGBoost — Confusion Matrix") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  })
  output$xgb_roc <- renderPlot(roc_gg(ALL$xgb$roc, "XGBoost"))
  output$xgb_imp <- renderPlot({
    imp <- ALL$xgb$importance
    ggplot(imp, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Gain), y = Gain)) +
      geom_col(fill = "#0891b2") +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(title = "XGBoost Feature Importance", x = NULL, y = "Gain") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  })
  observeEvent(input$xgb_go, {
    new <- matrix(c(input$xgb_age, input$xgb_inc, input$xgb_cs,
                    input$xgb_loan, input$xgb_emp), nrow = 1)
    colnames(new) <- c("Age","Income","Credit_Score","Loan_Amount","Employment_Years")
    p <- predict(ALL$xgb$model, xgb.DMatrix(new))
    verdict <- ifelse(p > 0.5, "Approved ✓", "Rejected ✗")
    color   <- ifelse(p > 0.5, "#0e7490", "#e11d48")
    output$xgb_prediction <- renderUI({
      div(class = "predict-result",
          div(class = "verdict", style = sprintf("color:%s;", color), verdict),
          div(class = "conf", sprintf("P(Approved) = %.1f%%", p * 100)))
    })
  })

  # ---- Random Forest ----
  output$rf_pred_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- data.frame(actual = ALL$rf$actual, pred = ALL$rf$pred)
    ggplot(df, aes(actual, pred)) +
      geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.75, color = "#0891b2") +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                  linetype = "dashed", color = "#e11d48") +
      labs(title = sprintf("Actual vs Predicted — R² = %.3f", ALL$rf$r2),
           x = "Actual MPG", y = "Predicted MPG") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  })
  output$rf_imp <- renderPlot({
    imp <- as.data.frame(ALL$rf$importance)
    imp$Variable <- rownames(imp)
    ggplot(imp, aes(x = reorder(Variable, `%IncMSE`), y = `%IncMSE`)) +
      geom_col(fill = "#34d399") +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(title = "Random Forest — %IncMSE", x = NULL, y = "% Increase in MSE") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  })

  # ---- KNN ----
  output$knn_cm  <- renderPlot({
    cm_gg(ALL$knn$cm$table) +
      labs(title = "KNN (k=5) — Confusion Matrix") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  })
  output$knn_roc <- renderPlot(roc_gg(ALL$knn$roc, "KNN"))

  # ---- Logistic ----
  output$logit_cm <- renderPlot({
    cm_gg(ALL$logit$cm$table) +
      labs(title = "Logistic Regression — Confusion Matrix") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  })
  output$logit_roc <- renderPlot(roc_gg(ALL$logit$roc, "Logistic Regression"))
  output$logit_coef <- renderTable({
    cf <- summary(ALL$logit$model)$coefficients
    df <- data.frame(Term = rownames(cf),
                     Estimate = round(cf[, 1], 4),
                     `Std. Error` = round(cf[, 2], 4),
                     `z value`   = round(cf[, 3], 3),
                     `p-value`   = format.pval(cf[, 4], digits = 3),
                     check.names = FALSE)
    df
  }, striped = TRUE, hover = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)

  # ---- K-Means ----
  output$km_scatter <- renderPlot({
    d <- ALL$km$data
    ggplot(d, aes(Annual_Income, Spending_Score, color = Cluster)) +
      geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("#0891b2","#f472b6","#fbbf24")) +
      labs(title = "K-Means Clusters (k = 3)",
           x = "Annual Income (k$)", y = "Spending Score") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  })
  output$km_sil <- renderPlot({
    sil_df <- as.data.frame(ALL$km$sil[, c(1, 3)])
    names(sil_df) <- c("Cluster", "Sil")
    sil_df$Cluster <- factor(sil_df$Cluster)
    ggplot(sil_df, aes(x = Cluster, y = Sil, fill = Cluster)) +
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.75) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0891b2","#f472b6","#fbbf24")) +
      labs(title = "Silhouette Width per Cluster",
           y = "Silhouette", x = "Cluster") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "none")
  })

  # ---- PCA ----
  output$pca_scree <- renderPlot({
    df <- data.frame(PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(ALL$pca$var_pct)),
                     Var = ALL$pca$var_pct)
    ggplot(df, aes(PC, Var)) +
      geom_col(fill = "#0891b2") +
      geom_line(aes(group = 1), color = "#e11d48", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(color = "#e11d48", size = 3) +
      labs(title = "Scree Plot", x = NULL, y = "% Variance Explained") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  })
  output$pca_biplot <- renderPlot({
    pca <- ALL$pca$model
    df <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2])
    load <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:2])
    load$Var <- rownames(load)
    scale_f <- 3
    ggplot(df, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.55, color = "#0891b2", size = 2) +
      geom_segment(data = load,
                   aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1 * scale_f, yend = PC2 * scale_f),
                   arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
                   color = "#e11d48", linewidth = 0.7,
                   inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      geom_text(data = load,
                aes(x = PC1 * scale_f, y = PC2 * scale_f, label = Var),
                color = "#e11d48", fontface = "bold", vjust = -0.4) +
      labs(title = "PCA Biplot (PC1 vs PC2)", x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  })

  # ---- ARIMA ----
  output$arima_plot <- renderPlot({
    autoplot(ALL$arima$forecast) +
      labs(title = sprintf("ARIMA%s Forecast (6 periods ahead)",
                           paste0("(", paste(arimaorder(ALL$arima$model),
                                             collapse = ","), ")")),
           x = "Time", y = "Temperature") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  })

  # ========================================================
  #  PORTFOLIO
  # ========================================================
  filtered <- reactive({
    df <- projects
    if (!is.null(input$cat_filter) && input$cat_filter != "All categories") {
      df <- df[df$category == input$cat_filter, , drop = FALSE]
    }
    q <- trimws(tolower(input$search %||% ""))
    if (nzchar(q)) {
      h <- tolower(paste(df$title, df$tools, df$category))
      df <- df[str_detect(h, fixed(q)), , drop = FALSE]
    }
    df
  })

  output$result_count <- renderText({
    n <- nrow(filtered())
    sprintf("%d project%s", n, if (n == 1) "" else "s")
  })

  output$project_grid <- renderUI({
    df <- filtered()
    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(div(style = "padding:60px 20px; text-align:center; color:#64748b;",
                 icon("magnifying-glass",
                      style = "font-size:2.2rem; margin-bottom:14px;"),
                 h3("No projects match your filters."),
                 p("Try clearing the search box or picking another category.")))
    }
    div(class = "grid", lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) make_card(df[i, ])))
  })

  # ---- Card modal ----
  observeEvent(input$card_clicked, {
    req(input$card_clicked)
    p <- projects[projects$id == input$card_clicked, , drop = FALSE]
    req(nrow(p) == 1)
    accent <- cat_colors[[p$category]]
    tags_list <- trimws(strsplit(p$tools, ",")[[1]])

    showModal(modalDialog(
      easyClose = TRUE, size = "l",
      title = tagList(span(class = "cat-badge", p$category),
                      span(style = "margin-left:14px;", p$title)),
      div(
        div(style = "display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; margin-bottom:20px;",
            div(style = sprintf(
                  "width:56px; height:56px; border-radius:14px;
                   background:linear-gradient(135deg,%s,%s);
                   display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
                   color:#fff; font-size:1.4rem;", accent, accent),
                icon(p$icon)),
            div(h3(style = "margin:0; font-family:'Fraunces',serif;", p$title),
                div(style = "color:#64748b; font-size:.85rem; font-weight:600;",
                    p$category, " · Project ", p$id, " of 24"))),
        h4(style = "font-family:'Fraunces',serif; margin:12px 0 8px;", "Overview"),
        p(style = "font-size:1rem; line-height:1.7; color:#1e293b;",
          "This project is fully documented in a reproducible R Markdown notebook."),
        h4(style = "font-family:'Fraunces',serif; margin:22px 0 10px;",
           "Tools & Techniques"),
        div(style = "display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px;",
            lapply(tags_list, function(t) span(class = "tag", t))),
        if (!is.na(p$live_lab)) {
          div(style = "margin-top:22px; padding:16px 20px;
                      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fef3c7,#fde68a);
                      border-radius:14px; border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.35);",
              icon("bolt"),
              strong(" This project has a live model demo."),
              " Head to the ", strong("Live Lab"), " tab to see it in action.")
        } else NULL
      ),
      footer = tagList(
        modalButton("Close"),
        if (!is.na(p$live_lab)) {
          actionButton("jump_to_lab", "Open Live Lab",
                       class = "btn-primary",
                       icon = icon("bolt"))
        } else NULL)
    ))
  })

  observeEvent(input$jump_to_lab, {
    removeModal()
    bslib::nav_select("navbar", "Live Lab")
  })
}

# ============================================================
#  RUN
# ============================================================
shinyApp(ui, server)
```
